correction: A per-sysext APT source was believed to be harmless in the shared mkosi.sandbox. mkosi's SandboxTrees= is universal, so every image of one invocation shares the sandbox and one repository metadata sync; one broken third-party repo therefore failed every build. The himmelblau source now lives in shared/himmelblau/sandbox and only the second mkosi invocation receives it.
evidence: PR #1092 CI runs 39616337275 and 39616337317 failed at apt-get update: the himmelblau Release file returned 404 for about 4 hours on 2026-10-21; mkosi 3c3a08fb SandboxTrees= SettingScope.universal
